Open the Agent Dashboard view at startup. The dashboard shows every session, top-level and subagents

Usage: aster dashboard [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --debug                 Enable debug logging
      --debug-file <FILE>     Write debug logs to FILE
  -h, --help                  Print help
      --leader-socket <PATH>  Use a custom leader socket path instead of the default `~/.aster/leader.sock`. A local/branch build can thus run an isolated leader without colliding with the default one already running on the machine Name it `~/.aster/leader-*.sock` to keep `aster leader list/kill` able to find it; any other location works but won't be auto-discovered
